title: Approve prepared opportunities exactly once
head: Commit containing this receipt; published SHA and commit-guard results are recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested feature stack on corrected F-09; keep all PRs unmerged.

baseline_review.parent_ci: Corrected F-09 head has passing Tests, Docker, Windows, AppleScript and label checks.

source_review.comparison: Pinned sources and current changes inspected. Reuses canonical publish/readiness and trigger services. The Authority effect boundary is unchanged.

figma.visual: Backend actions only; no UI change or screenshot claimed.

activation.requires: Current shared database, ready F09/Q13 preparation provider, configured trigger manager after startup.

implementation: Additive action receipts and permanent request-key aliases; one decision per proposal and exact revision.
Synchronous source/goal/bindings/qualification recheck, exact locked version and digest validation, existing publication service; publication, acceptance and receipt commit atomically.
Recoverable registration lease and truthful pending/registered/blocked states. Restart observes runtime subscriptions; late workers are fenced and receipt replay never republishes.
Exact-version trigger observation detects silent and partial failures. Partial cron retries reuse cached state without repeating remote enable hooks.
Separate dismissal fences late preparation, leaves workflow disabled and exposes a rechecked next proposal ID.
Strict authenticated no-store action routes, bounded streaming request parsing, privacy-preserving receipts, independent capability gate.
No graph recomposition, latest-draft substitution, incidental manual run, blanket Authority approval or business-outcome claim.

acceptance.check: Double click, different keys and restart retain one exact publication
acceptance.evidence: Durable file-backed tests; one receipt/flow, newer unrelated draft ignored; post-restart replay guarded against any republish.

acceptance.check: Changed revision, goal, graph, connection, target or quality prevents approval
acceptance.evidence: No publication, receipt, trigger call or run after refusal.

acceptance.check: Registration interruptions and refusals remain recoverable
acceptance.evidence: Deferred refresh, database reopen, late completion fencing, silent failure, explicit retry and partial local registration repair.

acceptance.check: Receipt failure rolls back publication and acceptance
acceptance.evidence: Injected SQLite receipt-insert refusal then same-key retry.

acceptance.check: Acceptance grants no later effect permission
acceptance.evidence: Synthetic subsequent notification creates an Authority approval request with zero deliveries.

acceptance.check: Dismissal is separate and supplies a current next identity
acceptance.evidence: Decision conflicts and no publication; final commit guards additionally exercise late-model dismissal.

affected.skip: Both actual-Q13 checks ran separately with the temporary dependency overlay.

q13_integration.method: Temporary overlay of the pinned prepared-qualification.ts, prepared-dry-run.ts and effect-capabilities.ts; restored in finally with byte checks.

initial_findings.resolution: An inherited 20 ms timeout fixture now freezes lease-clock time while retaining the real abort timer; Authority fixture now uses the runtime scoped piece identity. Both targeted regressions pass, then the full affected suite passes.

typescript.scope: Initial standalone check; final test/source changes are type checked again by the mandatory commit hook.

verification.guards: Normal commit hooks require EE, migration, template, package, final related tests and TypeScript. An initial hook found three missing Authority-test dependencies; corrected with isolated synthetic services. Final published result recorded in PR.
verification.manual_live_provider: not_run; no real credentials, paid models, messages or production daemon changes

activation_final.includes: Fresh-provider replay after restart, late-model dismissal and 25 blocked receipts without starving new approvals or later recovery observations.

registration_queue.resolution: Pending receipts have priority; local in-flight IDs are excluded and blocked observations rotate through bounded batches.

limitations: Default off and unavailable until its F09/Q13 dependencies are configured. Actual Q13 integration was local and simulated.
Exactly-once local publication is not a remote-provider exactly-once delivery guarantee. Existing ON_ENABLE hooks can have external effects and retain their existing uncertainty semantics.
Approval commits before asynchronous trigger registration. Clients must read registration state; HTTP success and accepted proposal state alone do not prove a live subscription or completed run.
The next proposal ID is a navigation hint and must be fetched again before deciding. No dashboard binding or F11 work is included.
Full repository CI for the new published head is tracked on the PR, separately from local affected checks.
rollback: Unset the activation flag and restart. Retain additive action tables, request keys, preparation records and workflows. Already approved workflows stay enabled; pause them explicitly using existing workflow controls if needed.
